user.title: Add EcoVent fan
user.description: Enter the address of your ventilation unit. It must be reachable on your local network.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the ventilation unit.
data_description.port: UDP port the unit listens on. Leave at 4000 unless you changed it.
data_description.name: Name used for the device in Home Assistant.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure EcoVent fan
reconfigure.description: Update the address of your ventilation unit, for example after it received a new IP address.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the ventilation unit.
data_description.port: UDP port the unit listens on. Leave at 4000 unless you changed it.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check that the address is correct and that the unit is powered on and connected to your network.
error.already_configured: This ventilation unit is already configured.

abort.already_configured: This ventilation unit is already configured.
